summary_of_core_decisions: The essay rejects the referential theory of meaning and the mind-dependent/mind-independent dichotomy, adopting instead a use-based account of meaning and language-games to show that emotional responses to fiction are meaningful without implying belief in existence. The paradox is thus dissolved, not solved.
